question: The office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner works under which Ministry of Government of India?

options.text: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Home Affairs**__

• The office of the **Registrar General and Census Commissioner** works under the **Ministry of Home Affairs** of the Government of India.
 
• The Registrar General and Census Commissioner is responsible for conducting the Census and various demographic surveys in India.
